newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stocks expected to head higher on Wall Street.
newsitem.headline: HK stocks expected to head higher on Wall Street.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks are expected to head higher on Tuesday following Wall Street's record close overnight, but investors are likely to turn cautious after a series of record-setting sessions, brokers said.
"Hong Kong should extend its upside before a correction will set in, mainly because of the better performance of overseas stocks," said Taiwan Securities dealing director Edwin Cheung.
The Hang Seng Index rose 57.00 points to a record close of 13,987.80 on Monday. Later, the Hang Seng London Reference Index edged up 19.36 points to 14,007.16.
